title: Delta Runway Ledger and Price Gearshift Projections
content:
Purpose:
A compact working ledger to test how shallow shifts in price and targeted headcount moves interact with runway and SLA-sensitive burst capacity. Goal is to identify minimal price or HC levers (<= 10% change) that recover runway by >= 4 weeks or reduce burn by >10% while preserving feature velocity for top two product initiatives.

High-level assumptions:
- Current cash runway baseline on 2026-05-01: 54 weeks at current burn.
- Monthly cash burn (base): $3,450k (incl. payroll, infra, opex): payroll 62%, infra 24%, other 14%.
- Average token price realized (hosted API): $0.00012 / token equivalent unit.
- Burst GPU reserve monthly cost: $120k (can be trimmed or converted to credits).
- Hiring cadence: 1.5 net hires/week if not deliberately slowed. Avg fully-loaded cost per HC (incl benefits & equity): $25k / month.

Scenario matrix (summary):
Scenario,Price delta vs base,Net HC change (Q3),Monthly burn delta ($k),Runway delta (weeks)
Base,0%,+12,+420,0
Growth-tilt (-price to win),-6%,-24,+560,-6
Price-tighten (raise),+8%,-9,-225,+3
Conservative-ops (trim burst),0%,-6,-140,+2
Hybrid (price + ops),+4%,-10,-510,+5

Quick interpretations:
- Small price increase (+8%) with modest hiring freeze (-9 HC) improves runway ~3 weeks but risks enterprise take-rate on dedicated accounts (monitor MRR churn).
- Shaving burst pool and converting to prepay credits (Conservative-ops) recovers ~2 weeks; low product impact but reduces peak headroom.
- Growth-tilt (cut price 6%) to capture expansion requires aggressive hiring to deliver volume (+24 HC) and actually shortens runway by ~6 weeks unless adoption yields >30% usage uplift in 6 months (unlikely).

Detailed month-on-month excerpt (May-Oct 2026) - key line items (k$):
Month,Payroll,Infra,Burst,Other,Total Burn,Net HC change,Notes
2026-05,2140,828,120,362,3450,+6,May hires ramp
2026-06,2185,840,120,375,3520,+4,mid-quarter offers
2026-07,2240,860,90,365,3555,+2,burst reserves trimmed 25%
2026-08,2210,780,90,340,3420,-10,freeze starts (attrition)
2026-09,2160,760,60,330,3310,-6,reduce infra tails, commit shift to credits
2026-10,2100,740,60,320,3220,-4,operational tightening

Key levers and sensitivity rules (working):
- Price elasticity quick rule: ~-0.28 elasticity for platform access (i.e., 6% price cut -> +1.68% usage likely only short-term). Use real-time billing signals before committing.
- HC cooling: Defer 1 hire / week -> saves ~25k/month per deferred HC; but hiring freeze beyond 8 weeks increases outage risk on product roadmaps.
- Burst reserve conversion: moving 70% of burst spend to prepaid credits reduces monthly realized burn by ~50% in Q after conversion due to accounting reclassification and committed discounts.

Immediate action items (owner and short tasks):
- Maya: run cohort-level elasticity check on top 20 customers (by ARR) by 2026-06-09 (linked JIRA-FIN-812).
- Priya: model hire-freeze scenarios with SDE/infra mix impact on SLIs by 2026-06-05 (deliver delta to product-sre).
- Eli: vendor renegotiation for burst credits and prepay options; target 18% effective cost reduction on burst budget by 2026-07-01.

Open questions / risks:
- How correlated is token mix shift with price changes (embeddings heavy customers may be sticky)? Need usage histogram by model family.
- Enterprise pipeline: will small price increases increase churn risk on multi-region Dedicated contracts? (legal notice windows).
- Downstream product velocity: which 2 features are absolute must-deliver vs deferrable if HC trimmed?

Notes to self: this is a living sheet. Prefer running the hybrid scenario in a canary region first (EMEA west) to validate elasticity and infra usage. Save pivot scenarios as separate tabs if we move to a canonical workbook.

Bottom line (working recommendation): prioritize a hybrid path: +4% price with a 6-10 HC targeted freeze and convert 50-70% burst pool to prepay credits. Expected net runway improvement ~4–6 weeks while maintaining minimal disruption to core product shipments.
